title: Repo, Next.js 15 + App Router wiring, Vercel deploy
goal: Stand up the Next.js 15 App Router skeleton and get it deployed to a live Vercel URL, so every subsequent story in this epic (and every epic after it) has a real deploy target from hour one of the build.
in_scope: Next.js 16 project init, App Router, TypeScript
Repo structure that matches the stack decisions: Server Actions for mutations, Route Handlers for webhooks/cron (ADR-0005, docs/architecture/02-tech-stack.md)
Vercel project linked and deployed on the free/hobby tier (ADR-0005)

Env var scaffolding documented (placeholders) for secrets later stories will wire up: Supabase service-role key, Gemini API key, Resend API key — none functional yet, just the contract for where they live
TanStack Query and Zod installed as base dependencies (docs/architecture/02-tech-stack.md) — not yet used by any feature
out_of_scope: Astryx vs shadcn/ui installation or theming — that's the separate Day-1 hour-1 spike decision (ADR-0002), made alongside this story but not part of it
Database schema or Supabase project provisioning (S-02)
Any product screen or feature code
acceptance: Empty app deployed to a Vercel URL within the first hour of Day 1.
invariants: No secret (Supabase service-role key, Gemini key, Resend key, or any future key) ever ships in the client bundle — this holds from the very first deploy, not just once S-02/S-03 add real integrations (ADR-0004, PRD REQ-26)
Single deploy target: Vercel (ADR-0005) — no parallel hosting experiments
